3 camps. Same fighter. Different approach to nutrition. 🥊

July 25th🥊 Lewis wasn’t eating JoJosFlavours.

Nov 25th🥊he started having the odd meal from me, but was still mainly sorting his own nutrition.

Sept 26th🥊 entire camp fuelled by me!! breakfast, dinner and tea, every day & also fight week!

Consistent meals. Proper portions. High protein. Nutrition taken care of so he can concentrate on training and performing.

The pictures speak for themselves 👀

This is exactly why nutrition is such a huge part of fight camp. 🥊🍴
